title: Attempt keys are scoped to the work item and run; sub-agent identity fields are bounded at the core write boundary
outcome: Attempt keys are scoped to the work item and run; sub-agent identity fields are bounded at the core write boundary
acceptance: explicit attempt keys are scoped explicit:<work_id>:<run_id>:<key>; a reopen test resends the same explicit key and payload on the new run and records fresh, while a same-run exact resend replays and a same-run contradicting payload conflicts; the brief's R8 documents the scope

parent_session is bounded by the live session-id rule and execution_identity by a documented 256-byte, no-control-character bound at validate_request_shape; direct-core tests show refusal with the run feed head unchanged and acceptance at the valid edge; R9 lists both bounds

completion.summary: Explicit attempt keys are scoped explicit:<work_id>:<run_id>:<key>: the reopen test resends the same key on the new run and records fresh (RED logs/19: conflict), same-run exact resend replays and a contradicting same-run payload conflicts, R8 updated. validate_request_shape bounds execution_identity (256 bytes, no control characters) and parent_session (live session-id rule); the direct-core test proves refusal with the feed head unchanged and admission at both edges (RED logs/19: oversized identity admitted); R9 updated. GREEN logs/20 and /22.
